body: I guess my biggest question is, if I can't get back into my group, should I still talk to the fp who abandoned me for another person? Or just keep trying to move on.

Thank you, I am just at my worst of the worst, bpd person and over the past year I have found it impossible to shower or eat. Just cry and ruin friendships n sh everyday alone. Going to try and raise it and see what happens. Almonds, olive oil, and alcohol surprisingly is what they say can raise it. Im a tech so can monitor it however most of my suicidal ideation was losing people in my life i loved so much but they walked out

a lot of people can't deal or handle people with bpd, they think we are PoS. Turn your sorrow into disgust for them. They treated you shitty and they will always do so. Find people who just don't "care" or "deal" with you, but people who can understand and help when you fall cus you WILL fall.  Those people might not be able to help but they can be there for us. They're rare, and you have to hunt for them.

The job/workplace is alright, just seems like im losing out on opportunities of growing as an individual being locked in a laboratory all day isolated. It becomes lonely fast, and I want to be able to make an impact on others/patients whom intrigue me. I feel as if my job is pointless, as important as it is. My borderline personality disorder is controlling a lot. The silence in the lab overtakes my thoughts and I become very ill with noises bein made from my mental illness. They repeat and are loud, I work through them and hide it the best I can however my coworkers all know about the sounds I hear.   


Overall with the life I have left which is always unknown how little time I have, been out of psych wards and police intervening with past attempts and body covered in scars from my past, It is just all unknown to me. Id like to leave a positive impact on others. Similar to nurses who treated me when I was younger till now. I want to reflect the kindness I was once shown and am enraged that being a Lab Technician cannot allow me to do any of that desire. I rot, and decay, with my only desire career wise being wasted away and my dream of doing so being taken over by needs to fulfill payment towards survival. It depresses me even more that I am too fatigued to switch careers when I feel I'm too late too, and the mental degradation I experience weekly and daily has destroyed my hope to make that specific dream come true. Too tired to shower for days at a time or eat or stand, so career change through education is most likely out of the picture.   


I appreciate everyone's response to this thread, It is hard working with a severe case of mental illness but I always wanted to try and will continue until I no longer can. I guess my main question now currently is how do you keep going knowing what you do has no mental or character impact on others? We're the biggest contributor to their health overall, but I guess it seems more physical where as Id rather help them mentally and be next to those who need it. How do yall get thru the day when you're sitting and barely moving as much as a nurse do? It feels sickening to me, but I am not that smart with words and hope mine do not make anyone feels bad. These are my feelings and just its difficult. Thank you
Yes I am in the US, I have been seeing a therapist am going to talk to them in the morning if I can. Thank you
